# CANDIDATE: ADAPTIVE_CHART_STOP_BUFFER_VIX_TIERS

**Filed:** 2026-09-08  
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)  
**Type:** exit_change  
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

The fixed $0.50 chart-stop buffer in BEARISH_REJECTION_RIDE_THE_RIBBON may be suboptimal across volatility regimes. In low VIX (<15), a tighter buffer could reduce whipsaws; in high VIX (>20), a wider buffer could avoid premature stops during volatile expansion. We hypothesize that adaptive buffer sizing per VIX tier will improve edge capture on J winner days while reducing losses on J loser days.

## Mechanism

Replace the static chart_stop_buffer_dollars ($0.50) with a dynamic buffer based on real-time VIX:
- VIX < 15: buffer = $0.30
- 15 ≤ VIX ≤ 20: buffer = $0.50 (baseline)
- VIX > 20: buffer = $0.70
The buffer is evaluated at entry time using the current VIX value. All other exit logic (chandelier profit-lock, premium stop, time stop) remains unchanged.
